title: Sree Narayana Law College To Organise International Seminar On Law & Governance Of Global Healthcare In Digital Age
description: Sree Narayana Law College, Ernakulam, in association with IQAC, SNLC Legal Aid Clinic, and Chikitsaneethi, Thrissur, is organizing a Two-Day International Seminar (Hybrid) on "Law and Governance of Global Healthcare in the Digital Age: Navigating AI, Climate Justice, Human Rights and IPR" on 08–09 August 2026.
